mapper.select: SELECT room_no as roomNo, accommodation_no as acmNo, room_name as roomName, room_qty as roomQty, room_price as roomPrice, room_discount as roomDiscount, room_contents as roomContents, room_viewtype as roomViewType, room_capacity as roomCapacity FROM room r , accommodation a WHERE accommodation_no = #{acmNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room ( room_name, room_qty, room_price, room_discount, room_contents, room_viewtype, room_capacity, accommodation_no ) VALUES ( #{roomName}, #{roomQty}, #{roomPrice}, #{roomDiscount}, #{roomContents}, #{roomViewType}, #{roomCapacity}, #{acmNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET room_name = #{roomName}, room_qty = #{roomQty}, room_price = #{roomPrice}, room_discount = #{roomDiscount}, room_contents = #{roomContents}, room_viewtype = #{roomViewType}, room_capacity = #{roomCapacity} WHERE room_no = #{roomNo}
mapper.select: SELECT a.accommodation_no AS acmNo, a.accommodation_name AS acmName, a.accommodation_address AS acmAddress, a.accommodation_contents AS contents, a.checkin AS checkinTime, a.checkout AS checkoutTime, a.tel AS acmTel, a.keyword_no AS keywordNo, a.business_no AS businessNo, a.category_no AS categoryNo FROM accommodation a, room r JOIN room r ON a.accommodation_no = r.accommodation_no WHERE r.room_no = #{roomNo}
